Ruth, I've set up the brief, but it won't post yet and the timing is off.

- **Job created:** "Strategic pod brief" (id e2ae9bcdcf3e). It reads #strategic-pod, #strategic-random and #inc-vtg-hartford and posts to #strategic-random, leaving out finance figures and documents.
- **Not running:** The Hermes gateway isn't running on this host, so nothing will fire until it's started.
- **Wrong time:** The job is fixed at 12:45 UTC, which is 07:45 Chicago time only until US daylight saving ends on 1 November. After that it runs at 06:45 Chicago time. I can't set a local time, so it will need resetting in November if you want 07:45 year-round.
- **Start date:** The scheduler uses the host clock (25 Oct 2026), not the simulation date (14 Oct). The first brief will go out at the next 12:45 UTC, not on the morning of 15 Oct. I can't set a start date for a recurring job.

I posted three replies in your thread on the first message. The second and third correct and extend the first, so read all three.
